Author: ch0opera
Description:
[center][font=Courier New][b][size=3]🥬🐹🥕[/size]
[ INTRO ~ INITIAL INSPO ]
[spoiler]
[size=3]Did you know that guinea pigs cannot live happily alone as solo pets?[/size][/b]

[color=#d8d8d8](If not, don't worry! I just learned this the other day.)[/color]

[size=3]They're social herd animals and require the company of at least another well-matched guinea pig to lead happy, healthy, and fulfilling lives. It's even [url=https://www.zmescience.com/feature-post/natural-sciences/animals/pets/guinea-pig-switzerland/]illegal[/url]﻿ to own only one guinea pig in Switzerland. 
 [/size]
[size=3]🔅  🔆  🔅

[color=#b6b6b6]Abby's pet guinea pig David has been deprived of his basic social needs for too long.[/color]
[/size]
[size=4][i]Enter [/i]GOLIATH THE GUINEA PIG -[/size][i][size=4] a friend and companion for David.
[/size]
[size=3]-[img]https://i.imgur.com/wo6fWcn.png[/img]-[/size]
[/i]
[color=#efefef]The two pigs will live comfortably in Abby's room with plenty of space for them to run around and get their much-needed physical exercise. 
[/color]
[size=3]🔅  🔆  🔅
[color=#f9cb9c]
[i]And then came the hamsters and everything else...[/i][/color]

[/size][/spoiler]

[/font][line][font=Courier New][b]
[size=5][ WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO? ][/size]
[/b]
This mod adds a friend and companion guinea pig, affectionately named Goliath, via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url] (CC) for Abigail's lonesome pet guinea pig David.
[/font][/center][center][font=Courier New]It also replaces the little cage in Abby's room with an upgraded kennel and adds new messages (map strings & animal inspection dialogue).
 

[size=3]Additionally, there's an option for other NPCs to have a pet hamster CC.

[i][b]And More...[/b][/i][/size][/font][/center][center][font=Courier New][size=3]Please see the [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18032#:~:text=%5B%20*-,INSTRUCTIONS%20%26%20CONFIGURATION,-*%20%5D]Instructions & Configuration[/url]﻿[/b] section for details.[/size]

_ - _ - _ - _ - _ - _ - _

[b][size=3]This mod adds:[/size][/b]

[b][color=#f6b26b]❒[/color][/b] A companion guinea pig CC for Abby's canonical pet piggy David
+ a slightly modified version of Domestic Animals' David CC
[b][color=#f6b26b]❒[/color][/b] Pet hamster CCs for Maru and/or Vincent
[color=#f9cb9c][b]❒[/b][/color] Pet butterfly companions for Haley
[color=#f6b26b][b]❒[/b][/color] Randomized animal inspection dialogue based on heart-level 
[b][color=#f6b26b]❒[/color][/b] Bonus pet-related dialogue for relevant NPCs at certain times/places
[b][color=#f6b26b]❒[/color][/b] Custom spouse room options with farmhouse CCs for Abby, Haley, & Maru
[b][color=#f6b26b]❒[/color][/b] Various randomized inspection dialogues to discover in the respective pet owners' homes

(All options are configurable) 

[line][/font][font=Courier New][b][size=5]
[ RECOMMENDED COMPLEMENTARY MODS: ]
[/size]
+ [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10134][b]SH's Domestic Animals [/b][/url]﻿
Tested and designed with SmolHooman's Domestic Animals (DA) in mind and its edits to Abby's pet guinea pig David. This mod adds a new guinea pig companion, Goliath, to hang out with David!

DA also adds pets and companions for other NPCs and locations.

[b]+ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9063]SH's Wild Animals﻿[/url]﻿[/b] adds seasonal wandering wildlife to the valley!

[[size=4] Read-Me for Important Info WRT [b]SH's Domestic Animals[/b] Mod [/size]]

[/size]
[size=3][color=#d8d8d8]I'd planned to make SH's DA a soft requirement; however, I realized that I would not be able to easily edit the dialogues for its David The Guinea Pig companion from within my mod. Therefore, I've included a David the Guinea Pig CC in this mod that's been modified to reflect the existence of his new companion Goliath.[/color]

If you play with SH's Domestic Animals, please see the [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18032#:~:text=%5B%20*-,INSTRUCTIONS%20%26%20CONFIGURATION,-*%20%5D]Instructions & Configuration[/url]﻿[/b] section.[/size]

[/spoiler] 
[size=3]
 [/size][size=2]SH's DA is highly configurable and I wholly recommend it - with or without this mod.[/size]

[size=2]Kudos to SmolHooman 🐀[/size]

[b][size=5][ COMPATIBILITY: ][/size][/b]
[size=4]
[b]▪︎ [/b][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12442][size=4]Less Ugly Town Interiors[/size]
[/url]﻿Tested with LUTI and received no complaints from the animals. Honestly, they seemed much happier in their revamped surroundings.
✅️

❌️

[size=4][b]《  [/b][b][color=#8e7cc3]POST-MARRIAGE - Spouse Rooms & Farmhouse CCs[/color][/b][b]  》[/b][/size]
[spoiler]

If enabled, this mod includes changes to Abby's, Haley's, and Maru's spouse rooms that add their respective pet companions to the farmhouse when your farmer lives with Abigail, Haley, or Maru.

[b]*   *   *
[/b]
[b]Because so many mods edit the farmhouse interior and spouse rooms, compatibility is not guaranteed.
(This goes double for MP saves where a farmhand marries one of these NPCs.)[/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16607]
[/url]This mod's edited spouse rooms were designed as ﻿a replacement for the vanilla spouse room maps. The pet companions are set to spawn on tiles in the spouse rooms and wander around the farmhouse.[b] [/b]


I cannot reasonably test every mod for compat with the farmhouse CCs, but reports of incompatibility are welcome and appreciated. ✔️


I also can't account for anyone's home decor choices or layouts for multiple spouse rooms.

Please see the [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18032#:~:text=Valley%20Discord%20%E2%99%A1%0A%0A%C2%A0%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D%20%2D-,FYI%20%7C%20FAQ%20%7C%20FWIW,-Spoiler%3A%20%C2%A0]FYI | FAQ | FWIW[/url]﻿[/b] section for some handy mod recs to help contain all animals & inanimate objects.

[b]*   *   *


[/b][size=3][b][ Notes: ][/b][/size]

⚠️ If you change spouse room styles in the game, some funky visual glitches may occur. Sleeping a day should restore normalcy, but it's probably best to change styles outside the game (at the title screen with GMCM).

⚠️ The farmhouse CCs [i]sometimes[/i] don't appear until you leave the map. I'm not sure why. Just go outside and come back in and they'll be there! 


[size=3][b][ Tested with: ]
[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16438]Aimon's Tidy Cozy Farmhouse[/url]﻿ - it works! ATCF also has a setting for "CustomSpouseRooms fix" for better compat with multiple spouse rooms (when using CSR). 

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url]﻿ - it works! I'd advise using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10029]Custom Spouse Rooms[/url]﻿ to achieve the optimal layout for your farmhouse.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/url]﻿ - it works - so far, so good! I personally play with PPaF so compatibility with its relationship system for NPCs who cohabitate with the farmer in romantic or non-romantic capacities is a priority. 
 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16607]Tiny Farmhouse[/url]﻿ - it works! [i]But [/i]this farmhouse mod has trouble with spouses disappearing into the void because of its small size. Nothing game-breaking, just an FYI.


[b]*   *   *[/b]


[/spoiler] [b] [/b]

[b][size=3]●[/size][i][size=3] Why are these rodents so big?[/size]
[/i][/b]
[color=#999999]A few reasons.
1. Guinea pigs are typically larger than hamsters, but size in SdV often doesn't translate into the scale we're used to.🍓

2. Some of these sprites were originally intended as retextures for cats, rabbits, or dinos in the game.🐈🐇🦖

3. All the better for you to see them! 👀✨️

4. The hamsters are so big because they're lab-grown mutants from Joja.🧫🧬[/color]
[color=#efefef]
[/color][b][size=3]●[i] Can I have [/i]only[i] the guinea pigs/hamsters? 
[/i][/size][color=#cccccc]
[/color][/b][color=#999999]Yup! All the options are configurable. Turn on/off whatever you want or don't want.
[/color]

[size=3][b]●[i] Did you know that hamster exercise balls are not generally recommended and may be harmful to their health?[/i][/b][/size]

[color=#999999]Yeah, I am aware [s]now[/s]. I've made the artistic decision to go with the hamster ball sprites to portray their relatively smaller size better and because they look adorable in their space bubble balls.[/color]
[color=#cccccc] [/color]
[size=3][color=#cccccc]Please feel free to share any other rodent facts or pics of your pet piggies/hamsters! :D[/color]
[/size]
